lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized into vertical columns starting posterior to the gill region and continuing along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal alignments of high-luminance blobs, forming a consistent grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Longitudinal horizontal ridges located on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the top edge to shadow on the bottom edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two vertical linear features of lower pixel intensity on the lateral flank, indicated by white digital arrow overlays.
other_distinctive_markers: The image includes two white digital arrow graphics pointing to specific spot patterns on the flank.
